text:
Predicates:
MondayAt8PM(x) ::: x is a Monday at 8 pm.
GivesOutOnTV(x) ::: x are roses given out on TV.
OnBachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad(x) ::: x is Breaking Bad.
Question: Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Breaking Bad is on Monday at 8 pm.
Predicates:
MondayAt8PM(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is on Monday at 8 pm.

Premises:
∀x (GivesOutOnTV(x) → OnBachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (OnBachelor(x) → PortraysRealPeople(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysRealPeople(x) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.

Conclusion:
MondayAt8PM(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is on Monday at 8 pm.
